title: Brain & Neuromorphic
intro: How brains compute and how to build machines that compute like them: spiking networks, neuroscience, cortical columns and neuromorphic chips.

items: Spiking Neural Networks (#/brain/snn): Neural networks whose neurons communicate via discrete spikes over time.
Neuroscience (#/brain/neuroscience): The biology the models aim at: cortical columns, population dynamics, insect brains, neural manifolds and neural cell types.
Foundations (#/brain/foundations): Frameworks for building cognition from spiking neurons: the NEF, semantic pointers and Legendre memory.
Neuromorphic Hardware (#/brain/neuromorphic-hardware): Chips that compute the way spiking networks do: event-driven, parallel, memory beside compute.

Computational Cortical Columns (#/brain/computational-cortical-columns): A learning path from the biology of the neocortical column to building one in spiking neurons: neuron models, plasticity, HTM, the Thousand Brains Theory, other column models, and a practical build roadmap.
